SQL regex may miss dynamic DDL, complex ALTER, column rename targets, or conditional execution
V193 renames seven tables in a comma-separated RENAME TABLE statement
Backup/retired legacy tables are not automatically required in greenfield vNext
A candidate mapping is not data semantic equivalence, and crosswalk only covers partial domain sources
Non-Flyway SQL scripts exist; no evidence of execution / current presence
No access to legacy live information_schema
